comparison.objective: Hold an antistatic bag, slide a circuit board fully into it, then place and release the bag in a crate; the candidate calibrates a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-620 tests bimanual hold-and-insert of a thin board into a constrained cavity followed by package transfer; the candidate tests two-tool angular adjustment and torque counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-620 requires board containment, bag placement on the crate floor, release, and stillness; the candidate requires opening-angle accuracy, nut retention, cycle repeatability, drift control, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Thin-board insertion into packaging does not test threaded setting retention.
